title: Rainwater Harvesting Basics
publisher: Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
summary: The Department promotes awareness of rainwater harvesting and artificial recharge of groundwater to help meet present and future water needs.

sections.heading: Basic context
sections.content: Rainwater harvesting and artificial recharge of groundwater are water-resource measures highlighted in the Department's awareness objectives.

sections.heading: General guidance only
sections.content: This document provides basic conservation context. It does not provide site design, permission, or local implementation requirements.

scope: General rainwater-harvesting and groundwater-recharge context only; no site design, permissions, or local requirements.
